g.text: Autonomous, Local-First Linux Workstation Assistant | System Topology & Component Pipeline
Browser SpeechRec API | FFmpeg pipeline fallback | Audio chunk validation
Sanitizes control tokens | Classifies intent (Conversational vs OS Execution)
Session history | Active model selection | Security confirmation context
LAYER 3: COGNITIVE & PLANNING ENGINE (LLM OUTSIDE PRIVILEGED PATH)
• Emits strictly typed TaskPlan data contract
LAYER 4: ZERO-TRUST SAFETY, SECURITY & GOVERNANCE GATEWAY
🟢 LOW: Safe reads, telemetry, status queries
🔴 HIGH: Sudo, VM creation, deletion, packages
• Evaluates action_type, tool, and target args
• Flags high-risk actions for user authorization
• Halts execution for all HIGH-risk actions
• Logs tool calls, exit codes, and outcomes
• Inspectable in GUI & audit log file
LAYER 6: OFFLINE SUBSYSTEMS, RESOURCE GOVERNOR & PERSISTENCE
• Native audio players: ffplay, mpv, SAPI
• Cosine similarity search for local RAG
LAYER 7: OPERATING SYSTEM, KERNEL & HYPERVISOR BOUNDARY
• WSL2 Linux environment with Windows host interop
• cgroups v2 resource quotas & process isolation
• Strict privilege separation: app stays in userspace
• QEMU system emulator with headless VNC/SPICE
• Isolated sandboxes for high-risk software tests
